abstract: This paper presents a novel analysis of the impact of environmental regulations aimed at reducing emissions in international trade in goods. Using a panel dataset of OECD and non‐OECD countries spanning from 2007 to 2018, we estimate a gravity model of trade using a Poisson pseudo‐maximum likelihood estimator with high‐dimensional fixed effects, controlling for potential confounding factors. Our empirical analysis integrates emissions intensity data with detailed international trade information at the industry level, considering both market‐based and non‐market‐based environmental policies. We estimate models for disaggregated trade flows, distinguishing between dirty and non‐dirty industries, and among heterogeneous groups of countries. Our findings indicate that stricter environmental regulations tend to increase imports of OECD countries from non‐OECD countries mostly in pollution‐intensive industries.
title: Environmental Stringency and International Trade

abstract: We introduce CHILE, an asset-pricing framework with asymmetric information, general utility functions, and arbitrary payoffs. It features a large economy (LE) with continuous-and-heterogeneous information (CHI). The defining feature of this information structure is that the total amount of information stays finite as the economy grows large. We use the framework to study how concentration—the presence of market participants of different sizes—affects market quality, namely liquidity and information efficiency. Greater concentration proves a double-edged sword: it raises liquidity but harms information efficiency. (JEL D01, D53, D82, E19, G12, G14)
title: CHILE

abstract: We study behavior‐based price discrimination (BBPD) in a two‐period Hotelling market in which consumers choose both where to buy and how much to buy, and consumers and firms may discount the future differently. For the symmetric interior solution we characterize, BBPD lowers second‐period prices, but its first‐period pricing incentives reflect two channels. The consumer‐side effect captures how consumers' anticipation of future poaching offers changes their sensitivity to first‐period price differences when choosing between firms. The firm‐side effect captures how first‐period market share affects second‐period equilibrium profit and thereby firms' first‐period pricing incentives. At symmetry, a marginal increase in that share leaves second‐period profit unchanged under unit and isoelastic demand but reduces it under strictly increasing individual‐demand elasticity. The firm‐side effect is therefore zero in the two benchmarks but gives forward‐looking firms an incentive to raise first‐period prices in our setting. The consumer‐side effect can reinforce or oppose this incentive. For any fixed positive firm discount factor, BBPD harms consumers relative to uniform pricing when consumers place sufficiently little weight on the future, despite lower second‐period prices. Such losses do not arise in the unit‐demand and isoelastic benchmarks. Holding both discount factors fixed across demand specifications, linear‐demand comparisons show that elastic demand can reverse the profit effect of BBPD.
title: Behavior‐Based Price Discrimination in Elastic Demand Markets

abstract: We estimate the returns to temporary, legal migration using a randomized experiment with Indian applicants for construction jobs in the UAE. Individuals who migrate doubled their earnings. However, migrants paid substantial upfront costs to labor intermediaries and reported significant falls in well-being. We extrapolate linear marginal treatment effects for workers who declined the offer and find they would have similar pecuniary returns to migration but would experience larger drops in well-being. We estimate that accounting for the fall in well-being and the intermediary costs reduce the welfare gains of temporary migration to the UAE to one-half of the pecuniary gains alone.
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: The Costs and Benefits of Guest Worker Programs: Experimental Evidence from the India-UAE Migration Corridor,

abstract: As buildings become key sites for energy transitions, smart technologies are increasingly deployed to optimise energy use. Yet their effectiveness depends not only on technical performance but also on how they are integrated into everyday practices. This article examines the deployment of smart radiator valves in a 500-room student residence at a French engineering campus. Based on qualitative fieldwork combining interviews with residents and stakeholders, field observations and documentary materials, the study examines the interactions between technological scripts and everyday heating practices. Drawing on Social Practice Theory and Science and Technology Studies, the research identifies three analytical dimensions of sociomaterial frictions (material, competence and interpretive) that emerge as residents interact with the system. These frictions reveal how assumptions embedded in the technology (automation, standardisation and limited user intervention) encounter the heterogeneous infrastructures, competences and meanings through which residents organise thermal comfort in everyday life. By conceptualising frictions as an analytical lens for examining sociotechnical fit, the article contributes to practice-based research on smart energy technologies. It redirects analytical focus from user-centric models based on attitudes or awareness towards the situated processes through which technologies, infrastructures and everyday practices are assembled into workable (or unworkable) sociotechnical arrangements. The findings also highlight implications for the design and governance of smart-heating systems in collective housing, emphasising the importance of infrastructural readiness, user learning and transparent governance for supporting successful smart energy deployments.
title: Winter is coming: unfolding frictions through a practice-based view of smart heating technology use

abstract: This paper features a setting with two-dimensional information asymmetry on a firm’s fundamental (good or bad type) and the nature of its supplemental investment (improving upside potential, or mitigating downside risk). We examine the firm’s optimal design of the information system when the system can only address the dimension of fundamental. We show that, with only single-dimensional information asymmetry regarding the firm’s fundamental, greater informativeness on the firm’s fundamental type always improves efficiency. However, with two-dimensional information asymmetry, increasing informativeness about firm fundamental no longer guarantees higher efficiency and can be detrimental. The optimal information system trades off reducing information asymmetry and preserving firms’ incentives to invest, and it could be uninformative or optimistically biased, depending on the level of credit risk, which in our setting is higher when supplemental investment is more likely to improve upside rather than protect downside. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00524 .

title: Information Design with Supplemental Investment

abstract: The empirical risk minimization approach to data-driven decision making requires access to training data drawn under the same conditions as those that will be faced when the decision rule is deployed. However, we may be concerned that our training sample is biased in the sense that some groups (characterized by either observable or unobservable attributes) may be under- or over-represented relative to the general population; and in this setting, empirical risk minimization over the training set may fail to yield rules that perform well at deployment. We propose a model of sampling bias called conditional [Formula: see text]-biased sampling, where observed covariates can affect the probability of sample selection arbitrarily much but the amount of unexplained variation in the probability of sample selection is bounded by a constant factor. Applying the distributionally robust optimization framework, we propose a method for learning a decision rule that minimizes the worst-case risk incurred under a family of test distributions that can generate the training distribution under conditional [Formula: see text]-biased sampling. We apply a result of Rockafellar and Uryasev to show that this problem is equivalent to an augmented convex risk minimization problem. We give statistical guarantees for learning a model that is robust to sampling bias via the method of sieves, and propose a deep learning algorithm whose loss function captures our robust learning target. We empirically validate our proposed method in a case study on prediction of mental health scores from health survey data and a case study on intensive care unit length-of-stay prediction. This paper was accepted by Vivek Farias, data science. Funding: This research was supported by NSF grant SES-2242876. RS is further supported by a NSF GRFP under grant DGE-1656518, a Stanford Data Science PhD Fellowship, and a Stanford Diversifying Academia Recruiting Excellence (DARE) Fellowship. abstract: We investigate how stockouts of existing products influence the success of new product introductions. Our findings reveal that stockouts on incumbent items at the time a new product is launched are associated with higher sales of the new product for at least six months. This positive spillover is specific to new products and is most potent at the start of the product life cycle. To establish causality, we use instrumental variables based on historical stockouts and contemporaneous stockouts in other stores. Analysis of individual-level transaction data corroborates a trial-and-adoption mechanism: Stockouts of existing items prompt consumers to trial the new product, leading to increased repeat purchasing. By identifying inventory as a driver of product trial, this research highlights the importance of strategically timing new product launches and documents a previously unrecognized tradeoff for inventory policies. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, marketing. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02602 .

abstract: In decentralized dynamic matching markets, agents can benefit from sharing resources, but they will collaborate only if properly incentivized. Motivated by applications such as multihospital kidney exchanges and job-hunting markets, this paper proposes novel monetary and nonmonetary mechanisms to incentivize collaboration in such decentralized dynamic markets. We study a model in which multiple self-interested agents manage local multiway dynamic matching problems. Jobs of different types arrive stochastically at each agent, expire after a limited time, and yield rewards when matched. An agent’s job backlog and actions are the agent’s private information, and each agent aims to maximize its long-run average matching reward. We design simple mechanisms that incentivize agents to submit all jobs upon arrival, thereby enabling centralized matching. Our first mechanism, the marginal-value (MV) mechanism, reimburses agents based on the MV of their submitted jobs. This can be implemented in a nonmonetary way by randomly selecting an agent (with a specified probability) to perform a match and collect the associated matching reward. We show that under the MV mechanism, full job submission constitutes an approximate Nash equilibrium—that is, the gain from unilateral deviation vanishes as the number of agents grows. To further eliminate incentives for deviation, we propose a refined mechanism, the MV-plus-credit (MVC) mechanism, and show that, when the number of agents exceeds a constant threshold, full job submission constitutes a stronger oblivious equilibrium. Numerical experiments based on kidney exchange data demonstrate that the gains from deviation under our mechanisms are small even in moderately sized markets. This paper was accepted by Peng Sun, optimization and decision analytics. Funding: J. abstract: The growing demand for rapid food and grocery delivery has prompted many restaurants and retailers to develop their own on-demand delivery services. Although hiring additional couriers can expand delivery capacity, it is often prohibitively costly. As a cost-effective alternative, we propose a proximity-based delivery (PBD) policy that prioritizes the delivery of orders from customers located closer to the vendor, in contrast to the traditional first-come-first-served (FCFS) approach. We show that PBD can substantially reduce average delivery delays without requiring additional couriers; however, it may raise fairness concerns, because distant customers experience longer wait times, potentially shrinking market coverage and exacerbating service disparities. To address this issue, we introduce an incentive-compatible PBD (IP) policy, where nearby customers are incentivized to pay for priority, whereas distant customers receive compensation to offset longer delays. We demonstrate that this mechanism can restore fairness to levels comparable to FCFS while preserving efficiency, expanding market demand, and enhancing consumer surplus, particularly in moderately dense markets with moderately delay-sensitive customers. We further show that vendors can enhance these benefits through optimal pricing and benefit from less extreme staffing adjustments due to a “pull-to-center” effect. Our findings highlight the operational, economic, and ethical dimensions of proximity-based delivery, and offer a practical framework for balancing speed, profitability, consumer welfare, and equity. Finally, we conduct a mini case study using empirical data to demonstrate the real-world applicability of our approach. This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management. Funding: Z. abstract: We develop a deep learning framework to directly estimate tangency portfolio weights by augmenting benchmark factors with a long-short deep factor derived from high-dimensional characteristics. Guided by a Sharpe ratio maximization objective, the deep factor plays two key roles: (i) providing a natural hedge against benchmark risks and (ii) capturing multimarket signals to enhance the performance of the benchmark. In an empirical application to U.S. corporate bonds using 132 firm-level bond, equity, and option characteristics, the deep factor achieves an out-of-sample Sharpe ratio exceeding one, and the deep tangency portfolio benchmarked against the market factor yields a Sharpe ratio over two, outperforming portfolios spanned by common observable or latent factors. These results demonstrate that bond risk signals are fundamentally dense, requiring the nonlinear integration of multimarket information to span the efficient frontier. abstract: Urban green infrastructure (UGI) simultaneously supports ecological processes and recreational activities, and coordinating these two functions remains difficult for land-constrained cities. Spatial overlays and coupling coordination degree models are commonly used to evaluate this coordination. Neither approach identify the topological pathways through which subsystems depend on each other, nor trace how dependence shifts across scales, leaving UGI patches whose functional importance only emerges under joint multilayer analysis undetected. This study examines these questions in Shenyang, China. We constructed coupled ecological-recreational networks at municipal, main urban, and central urban scales. Ecological nodes were selected from UGI patches by conservation potential; recreational nodes by service supply capacity. Two indicators, multilayer versatility and single-layer centrality, evaluated the structural roles of individual patches. Results were as follows: (1) Coupling intensity follows an inverted U-shaped pattern, peaking at the main urban fringe. (2) Eco-recreational mixed communities concentrate at this intermediate scale, whereas recreational communities dominate in the central urban core. (3) A four-type classification was derived from the joint evaluation: synergistic hotspots, peripheral nodes, functionally isolated nodes, and bridging nodes. The latter two, whose single-layer and multilayer importance diverge, together account for about a quarter of all analyzed patches. These findings suggest that green space zoning based solely on single-layer evaluation may obscure the cross-functional value of these patches, risking biased management priorities. Multilayer network diagnostics should therefore inform land use decisions on conservation and recreational investment.

abstract: This paper studies dynamic decision problems in the presence of uncertainty and information arrival. A decision maker selects an action with uncertain payoffs from a menu of actions either before or after receiving information. Both the content and the timing of information are unobservable from the analyst’s point of view. The paper provides a theory of how revealed choices over menus of actions allow the analyst to elicit the decision maker’s expected timing of information arrival. I identify a specific form of preference for commitment that characterizes information that arrives after the decision maker selects an action from the menu. Conversely, a preference for larger menus indicates that information arrives before the action is selected–though this is a sufficient but not necessary condition. Indeed, when the decision maker has an intrinsic preference for information, a desire for commitment can emerge even if information arrives before selecting an action from the menu. Comparing the choices of two decision makers allows ranking them by their responsiveness to expected information.
title: Subjective timing of information arrival

abstract: We use matched employer–employee administrative data for The Netherlands to study the labor market effects of flexible employment contracts. Using an Abowd–Kramarz–Margolis (AKM) framework, we show that flexible contracts are associated with lower wages, a greater volatility of worked hours, and a higher probability of unemployment in the following year. However, our findings indicate that the disadvantages associated with flexible contracts arise not only from the contractual arrangement itself, but also from the types of firms in which flexible workers are employed. Specifically, workers on flexible contracts are disproportionately employed at lower-paying firms with lower firm-specific wage premiums. Furthermore, we find that flexible workers benefit less from employment at more profitable, larger, and financially safer firms, and that local labor market concentration amplifies their wage disadvantage. Overall, our findings imply that the negative effect of flexible contracts on wages may be overstated if the types of firms at which flexible workers are employed are not taken into account.
title: Flexible labor contracts, firm-specific pay, and wages

abstract: Many pump-and-dump event files record announcement times only to the minute. Using 316 Telegram messages with known seconds and Binance trades, I delete the seconds and recompute outcomes at all 60 compatible clocks. Among 281 events measurable at every clock, the mean ten-minute markout on first-minute aggressive purchases lies between −10.70% and −2.95%, so its sign survives; among 244 events, the mean price peak ranges from 2.16% to 42.64%. In a public file, the markout bound for the 6217 of 7920 min-only events measurable at every clock contains zero. Which conclusions survive coarsening must be checked sample by sample.
title: When seconds are lost: Timestamp coarsening in pump-and-dump event studies

abstract: Research on production networks focuses on physical disruptions that travel downstream. This paper studies a financial shock that removes customers' ability to pay. Using the 2022 freeze of Vietnam's corporate bond market and a difference-in-differences design on 502 listed firms, it finds that return on assets in the real estate value chain falls by 1.52 percentage points. The loss is largest at upstream material suppliers, 1.8 times that at the origin. The pre-shock receivables share predicts the loss, whereas short-term liabilities do not. When productive capacity is intact, payment links rather than supply links determine where the damage concentrates.
title: When customers' credit shocks travel up the supply chain: Evidence from the freeze of a real estate bond market

abstract: Education systems invest heavily in measuring teaching quality, most visibly through structured classroom observation instruments. I compare three measures of teaching quality — classroom observations, a teacher subject-knowledge test, and students’ perceptions of their teachers’ practices — as predictors of student learning growth over one school year in 393 Tanzanian primary schools. Students were linked to the teachers who taught them in each subject, and assessed at the beginning of the 2019 and 2020 school years. A one standard deviation increase in student-reported teaching quality (measured as the average rating of a student’s classmates) predicts 0.06 standard deviations more learning ( p < 0.01 ), equivalent to roughly one additional month of schooling. The relationship is not driven by the sorting of better students to better teachers, though it weakens to 0.03 standard deviations when comparing teachers within the same school. In contrast, classroom observations and teacher knowledge do not predict learning growth. A short student survey, cheaper to collect than a classroom observation, carries information about teacher effectiveness that neither the observation nor the knowledge test captures.
title: Ask what the teacher does: Student reports predict learning better than classroom observations in Tanzania

abstract: We investigate “spiritual insurance”—a mental strategy for coping with risk, where individuals engage in good deeds, including donations, in exchange for perceived blessings and protection. Using bank transactional data, we show that higher income uncertainty and health shocks lead to increased donations, particularly to religious charities. Moreover, individuals who donate to religious charities tend to reduce insurance expenditures. In a field experiment on millions of potential donors through an online platform, we find that spiritual insurance narratives increase giving, providing direct causal evidence for such a motive. Our findings provide new evidence on how spiritual insurance affects household risk-coping behavior.
journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: Hedging by Giving: Spiritual Insurance and Religious Donations

abstract: Repo markets are systemically important funding markets, but are also used by firms to obtain the assets provided as collateral. We build and structurally estimate a model of trade between heterogeneous firms in the sterling gilt repo market, and show that this collateral demand depresses repo market activity and can impede the transmission of monetary policy. We quantify how well-designed central bank repo facilities can improve outcomes: if the central bank were to lend out the assets on its balance sheet following quantitative easing, transmission and total firm surplus would improve by 20% and 38%, respectively.
title: Collateral Demand in Wholesale Funding Markets

abstract: An increasing number of bilateral investment treaties (BITs) establish a stable investment climate, which encourages both foreign direct investment and economic integration. Combining BITs data with the International Trade and Production Database and capitalizing on the latest developments in the empirical structural gravity literature, we investigate the effects of BITs on services trade. We find robust evidence of a positive effect of BITs on services trade: the presence of BITs increases services trade by 3.6%. This result is robust to an instrumental variable strategy addressing the endogeneity problem. We also find little evidence of trade diversion effects of BITs. At the industry level, there are substantial heterogeneity effects of BITs for members and non‐members.
title: Bilateral investment treaties and services trade

abstract: This article examines Brazil's oil-sector transformation from 1995 to 2025, emphasising how changes in auction cadence – the frequency and timing of bidding rounds organised by the National Agency of Petroleum, Natural Gas and Biofuels (ANP) – interacted with regulatory reforms, contractual regime shifts and Petrobras's asset strategy to shape investment, Local Content (LC) and fiscal outcomes. Using primary legal and institutional documents (laws, decrees, ANP bidding notices and results), Petrobras strategic plans and public time-series evidence on production, reserves, investments and government participations, the study traces three phases: early post-monopoly annual rounds that supported exploratory momentum; a pause and regulatory redesign around the pre-salt layer, a major offshore oil province, that altered incentives; and an accelerated sequence of rounds and open acreage offers (a continuous bidding modality) after 2016. Quantitative evidence shows Petrobras investment commitments fell from a 2012–2013 peak of roughly US$236 billion to about US$55 billion by 2021, while realised capital expenditure also contracted sharply after 2014. Offered LC rates in offshore exploration dropped from highs near 86% to around 18% in recent rounds. The analysis documents a negative synergistic association consistent with a mechanism whereby irregular auction cadence and state asset retrenchment may have jointly reduced conditions supporting domestic supplier demand. The analysis is descriptive and associational rather than causal. Policy recommendations include institutionalising a predictable auction calendar, reconfiguring LC instruments linked to finance and R&D (research and development), and measures to mitigate divestment impacts.
title: Auction cadence, Petrobras divestments and the institutional evolution of Brazil's oil sector (1995–2025)

abstract: Using a survey with information treatments conducted after the collapse of Silicon Valley Bank (SVB), we document novel findings about households’ perceptions on bank stability, the potential for bank runs, and the role of FDIC insurance and public communication. First, households are generally poorly informed about the banking sector and deposit insurance. Second, when informed about SVB’s collapse, households become more likely to withdraw deposits, even if insured. Third, households reallocate deposit withdrawals primarily into other banks and cash, with little passthrough into durable spending. Fourth, information about FDIC insurance or bank stability by the Federal Reserve reassures depositors, while communication from political leaders influences only their electoral base.
title: Keep calm and bank on: Bank run risks and the role of public communication

abstract: This study is the first to document that the effect of electronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) taxation on youth nicotine vaping has declined over time. Using data from several nationally representative data sources and a generalized difference-in-differences approach, we find that since 2020, the effect of a one dollar increase in ENDS taxes on teenage e-cigarette use has declined by over 50 percent. This erosion in tax responsiveness is consistent with the marginal youth vaper becoming more tax inelastic over time. Descriptive evidence shows that the composition of youth ENDS users has shifted toward those with a higher addictive stock and a greater taste for risk, factors that may make current youth vapers less tax responsive. In contrast, for adults — for whom there is less evidence of decline in ENDS use or compositional shifts among users — their behavioral response to ENDS taxation has remained largely unchanged over time.
title: Are E-Cigarette Taxes Losing their Bite?0F

abstract: As demand for postpartum contraception increases, a growing number of hospitals are adopting religious restrictions known as the Ethical and Religious Directives (ERDs) that explicitly prohibit contraception provision. Yet, despite ongoing state and federal policy debates, causal evidence on the longer term health consequences of institutional religious restrictions remains scarce. We use quasi-random variation in geographic proximity to hospitals with and without ERDs to evaluate the effect of giving birth at an ERD-adherent hospital on postpartum contraception and downstream reproductive health outcomes. Our instrumental variable approach uses data on 11 million birth hospitalizations from 2010–2023 across ten states. We find giving birth at an ERD-adherent hospital reduces permanent contraception by 3.72 percentage points (pp), a 60% decrease relative to the mean, with insignificant effects on non-permanent contraception in the full sample. However, this pooled estimate masks important differences by patient location: rural patients who delivered at an ERD-adherent hospital experienced 64% and 63% relative decreases in permanent and non-permanent contraception, respectively. Rural patients who gave birth at ERD-adherent hospitals were then 4.18 pp more likely to be pregnant within 18 months compared to those who delivered at non-ERD-adherent hospitals (a 30% relative increase), and also faced elevated risks of short-interval pregnancies complicated by severe maternal morbidity or preterm birth. For urban patients, ERD-adherent hospitalization did not significantly impact non-permanent contraception or short-interval pregnancy, consistent with greater access to non-hospital contraception options. These findings provide the first causal evidence linking hospital religious restrictions to adverse downstream health outcomes, informing policy debates on hospital transparency, merger oversight, and institutional conscience protections.
title: Downstream effects of restricted access to contraception: Evidence from hospitals with religious directives

abstract: Water‐scarce regions must plan long‐lived infrastructure under uncertain inflows, drought risk and future demand. Single‐decision‐point benefit–cost analyses (BCAs) can understate the value of flexibility when large, irreversible water‐supply investments are assessed without explicitly representing future decision opportunities. This study re‐examines the 2016 decision to construct the A$491 million Murray River pipeline for Broken Hill, New South Wales and asks whether a managed aquifer recharge (MAR) first strategy could meet the city's long‐term water‐supply objective at lower expected cost while avoiding premature commitment to irreversible capital investment. We develop a stochastic real‐options benefit–cost framework over a 30‐year planning horizon. Across 10,000 Monte Carlo simulations, the historical single‐decision‐point pipeline policy is compared with an adaptive MAR‐first policy in which the pipeline is retained as a contingent option and exercised only if available supply falls below 2.5 GL for two consecutive years. The three possible adaptive outcomes are evaluated jointly as one decision strategy, weighted by their simulated frequencies. The model incorporates probabilistic supply and demand variation, capital and operating costs, salinity and greenhouse‐gas externalities, and lower‐tail reliability using Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR). The adaptive MAR‐first policy has an expected present value of costs (EPVC) of A$372.1 million, compared with A$621.4 million for the benchmark pipeline policy, an expected saving of A$249.3 million (40.1%). The pipeline is exercised in approximately 5% of adaptive‐policy futures and remains unexercised in approximately 95%. Mean annual available supply is 9.58 GL/year under the adaptive policy compared with 7.70 GL/year under the benchmark. In the lowest‐yield 5% of simulated outcomes, average annual available supply is 2.52 GL/year under the benchmark policy and approximately 5.20 GL/year under the adaptive policy. Both values remain below the representative 7.5 GL/year demand benchmark, meaning that extreme drought conditions can still produce supply shortfalls; however, the smaller gap under the adaptive policy indicates substantially reduced lower‐tail shortfall exposure. The results show that MAR‐led sequencing can improve the cost‐reliability trade‐off while reducing expected lifecycle cost and premature capital commitment under deep uncertainty.
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Using Managed Aquifer Recharge to Defer High‐Capital‐Cost Investments and Avoid Lock‐In in Semi‐Arid Australia

abstract: We study the effect of the COVID-19 pandemic on corporate tax avoidance, using firm-level data from Slovakia and a difference-in-differences design that compares tax-unreliable and tax-reliable firms before and after the shock. Tax-unreliable firms increased their tax inefficiency by roughly 10 percentage points more than reliable firms following the pandemic's onset, a result robust to a synthetic difference-in-differences approach. The effect is concentrated among micro and small firms, while large firms show no significant response. Our findings show that aggregate economic shocks disproportionately widen the compliance gap between already non-compliant and compliant firms.
title: The effects of COVID-19 on corporate tax avoidance

abstract: Using nationally representative data from Chinese middle schools, we exploit random classroom assignment at school entry to estimate the effect of exposure to older classmates on mental health during the transition to middle school. We find that exposure to older peers significantly increases multiple indicators of emotional distress and a composite mental illness index. These adverse effects are more pronounced among rural students and students from lower socioeconomic backgrounds. Mechanism analyses suggest that these effects may be linked to poorer academic performance, worse peer interactions, and a less supportive school environment, while teachers’ pedagogical practices appear largely unaffected. Overall, our findings underscore classroom peer age as an underexplored aspect of the classroom environment, with meaningful implications for adolescent well-being.

abstract: This paper analyses the factors associated with spatial variations in the diffusion of augmentative digital technologies across Denmark from 2016 to 2019. We build on the literature on internal and external innovation modes, particularly the Doing, Using, and Interacting (DUI) mode, as a predictor of technology diffusion. The analysis draws on an employee-level survey on technology use in Denmark. Our findings show that the diffusion of augmentative digital technologies is spatially uneven, with slower technological diffusion in Old industrial regions than in Metropolitan regions. These spatial variations systematically co-occur with regional differences in the presence and impact of DUI. The study contributes to the literature by expanding the understanding of the relationship between innovation modes and the diffusion of augmentative digital technologies and linking these diffusion patterns to regional differences in innovation modes.
title: The diffusion of augmentative digital technologies and firm innovation mode: Employee level evidence from Danish regions

abstract: I develop and estimate a quantitative assignment model of a metropolitan housing market with connected quality segments and migration into and out of the metro. I discipline the model using new measures of house prices and housing stocks by initial quality segment across U.S. metros from 2000 to 2019. I use the model to study housing-supply counterfactuals in Los Angeles. Increasing Los Angeles’s housing stock to match growth in a comparison group of other metros lowers prices in Los Angeles throughout the quality distribution, even in low-quality segments that receive no new housing. Migration curtails this trickle-down mechanism, and supply added closer to the bottom generates much larger price reductions at the bottom than supply added higher up.
title: Trickle-down housing economics

abstract: Most economists oppose rent control, arguing that it reduces welfare because it distorts rental markets. A quantitative general-equilibrium model calibrated to Toronto shows that, consistent with the Second Welfare Theorem, rent control is welfare-reducing when the government can efficiently redistribute landlord profits to newborns. However, when fiscal redistribution is imperfect to empirically realistic degrees, common types of rent control improve welfare by serving as a second-best redistributive instrument. In this setting, the equity gains from transferring surplus to low-income renters outweigh the distortions caused by rent control.
title: Rent control? Bad in theory, not always in practice

abstract: This study examines the impact of artificial streetlights on sleep, as well as downstream effects on mental health, absenteeism, and physical activity. We exploit variation resulting from the replacement of traditional sodium streetlights with light-emitting diode (LED) lights in Burnaby, British Columbia, Canada. Using data from the Canadian Community Health Survey, we examine discontinuities in difficulty sleeping at the municipal border with Vancouver, which did not adopt new lighting. We also estimate a within-Burnaby model exploiting the rollout of LED lights across neighborhoods, and a difference-in-differences design using matched Vancouver and Burnaby neighborhoods. The estimates show that conversion reduces difficulty sleeping immediately, and that improvements in mental health, absenteeism, and physical activity follow with a lag of two to three years. The largest gains occur with warmer-toned LEDs that more closely mimic natural light.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察人工路灯对睡眠的影响，以及对心理健康、缺勤和身体活动的下游效应。我们利用加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省本拿比市将传统钠灯路灯替换为发光二极管（LED）灯所产生的外生变异。使用加拿大社区健康调查数据，我们考察与未采用新照明的温哥华市交界处的入睡困难断点。我们还估计了一个利用LED灯在各社区推广的本拿比市内模型，以及一个使用匹配的温哥华和本拿比社区的双重差分设计。估计结果显示，转换立即减少了入睡困难，而心理健康、缺勤和身体活动的改善在2至3年的滞后期后出现。最大收益出现在更接近自然光的暖色调LED灯上。

abstract: U.S. federal law mandates that most insurers offer contraceptives for free to patients, yet nearly one in three women of reproductive age still report inadequate access to contraceptive services. With demand-side affordability barriers largely removed, supply-side factors—the actions of healthcare facilities and providers—may be critical in explaining this unmet need. This paper examines supply-side determinants of long-acting reversible contraceptive (LARC) use among Medicaid beneficiaries, a population for whom both LARCs and oral contraceptives (OCs) are covered at zero out-of-pocket cost. Unlike OCs, LARCs require clinician insertion and upfront device stocking, making them especially vulnerable to supply-side forces. Using national Medicaid claims data from 2015–2019 and a movers design that separates place-based from patient-based variation, we find that local supply-side factors explain 58.5 percent of geographic variation in LARC use—substantially more than the 37.7 percent explained for OCs. We then estimate the causal effects of a supply-side policy that substantially lowers the cost of stocking LARCs for safety-net providers: the 340B Drug Pricing Program. Leveraging the staggered timing of program participation across clinics in an event-study design, we find that the arrival of the first participating clinic in an enrollee's ZIP code increases LARC use by 4.3 percent without displacing OC use or increasing LARC removals. Together, these findings identify the supply side as both a key source of unmet contraceptive need and a promising target for policy to improve access to the most effective forms of contraception.
abstract_zh: 美国联邦法律规定大多数保险公司必须向患者免费提供避孕药具，但近三分之一育龄妇女仍报告避孕服务获取不足。在需求侧可负担性障碍基本消除的情况下，供给侧因素——医疗机构和提供者的行为——可能是解释这一未满足需求的关键。本文考察医疗补助受益人中长效可逆避孕药具（LARC）使用的供给侧决定因素，该人群的LARC和口服避孕药（OC）均以零自付费用覆盖。与OC不同，LARC需要临床医生置入和预先设备储备，使其特别容易受到供给侧力量的影响。使用2015—2019年全国医疗补助索赔数据以及将地点变异与患者变异分离的迁移者设计，我们发现当地供给侧因素解释了LARC使用地理变异的58.5%——大幅高于OC的37.7%。然后我们估计了一项大幅降低安全网提供者储备LARC成本的供给侧政策的因果效应：340B药品定价计划。利用事件研究设计中各诊所参与计划时间的交错性，我们发现参保人邮政编码区域内首家参与诊所的出现使LARC使用增加4.3%，且未取代OC使用或增加LARC取出。总之，这些发现将供给侧确定为未满足避孕需求的关键来源以及改善最有效避孕形式可及性的有前景的政策目标。
title: Supply-Side Drivers of Long-Acting Reversible Contraceptives: Evidence from Medicaid Beneficiaries
title_zh: 长效可逆避孕药具的供给侧驱动因素：来自医疗补助受益人的证据

abstract: Uncovered interest parity (UIP) tends to hold at long horizons for advanced-economy currencies. Whether it holds in emerging markets remains a more open question. We show it does not, and that sovereign credit risk can explain the failure. Using monthly zero-coupon local-currency yield curves for all emerging market currencies for which they are available from 2000 to 2025, we find that the slope of long-horizon UIP regressions is well below one at the five-year maturity for emerging market currencies, while unity cannot be rejected for G10 currencies. However, when we augment these regressions with sovereign CDS spreads, this slope rises to values statistically indistinguishable from one for floating emerging market currencies. The correction works best for currencies whose credit risk is most variable. A no-arbitrage asset pricing framework guides the specification of the regressions and the interpretation of the results.
abstract_zh: 非抛补利率平价（UIP）在发达经济体货币的长期期限上往往成立。其在新兴市场是否成立仍是一个更开放的问题。我们表明它并不成立，并指出主权信用风险可以解释这一失败。使用2000年至2025年所有可获得数据的新兴市场货币的月度零息本币收益率曲线，我们发现新兴市场货币在五年期限上长期UIP回归的斜率远低于1，而G10货币则不能拒绝斜率为1。然而，当我们在这些回归中加入主权CDS利差后，对于浮动新兴市场货币，该斜率上升至与1在统计上无法区分的值。该修正对信用风险变化最大的货币效果最好。一个无套利资产定价框架指导了回归的设定和结果的解释。
title: Long-run Uncovered Interest Parity in Emerging Markets
title_zh: 新兴市场的长期非抛补利率平价

abstract: Growing climate risk threatens long-lived, fixed physical assets like real estate. To navigate this risk, homeowners and prospective buyers rely on market signals, including property values and insurance costs. The effectiveness of these market signals depends on whether standard economic assumptions hold. In this review, we assess whether housing and insurance markets accurately reflect climate risk, and whether market participants receive and respond to those signals. A rapidly growing literature documents substantial frictions in each part of the chain from climate risk to prices, with downstream consequences for adaptation and recovery. We conclude that these frictions call into question whether the price signals provided by real estate and insurance markets are likely to steer households into outcomes that are resilient to growing climate risk.
abstract_zh: 日益增长的气候风险威胁着房地产等长期固定实物资产。为应对这一风险，房主和潜在买家依赖市场信号，包括房产价值和保险成本。这些市场信号的有效性取决于标准经济学假设是否成立。在本综述中，我们评估住房和保险市场是否准确反映气候风险，以及市场参与者是否接收并响应这些信号。快速增长的文献记录了从气候风险到价格这一链条每个环节中的重大摩擦，并对适应和恢复产生下游后果。我们得出结论，这些摩擦使人们质疑房地产和保险市场提供的价格信号是否可能引导家庭走向能够抵御日益增长的气候风险的结果。

abstract: How much past growth is due to automation, and what does this imply for the future of AI? We perform task-based growth accounting and show that capital task productivity has grown about 5 percentage points per year faster than labor task productivity in the U.S. economy. The main benefit of automation is using rapidly improving machines instead of slowly-improving humans on more tasks. With these historical measures, we calibrate a growth model in which the production of goods and ideas is endogenously automated. Growth accelerates and can explode. However, the acceleration is slowed by "weak links," tasks still performed by labor.
abstract_zh: 过去增长中有多少归因于自动化，这对AI的未来意味着什么？我们进行基于任务的增长核算，并表明在美国经济中，资本任务生产率比劳动任务生产率每年快约5个百分点。自动化的主要好处是在更多任务上使用快速改进的机器而非缓慢改进的人类。利用这些历史度量，我们校准了一个商品和思想生产内生自动化的增长模型。增长加速并可能爆炸。然而，加速被“弱环节”——仍由劳动执行的任务——所减缓。
title: Past Automation and Future AI: How Weak Links Tame the Growth Explosion
title_zh: 过去的自动化与未来的AI：弱环节如何抑制增长爆炸

abstract: Bureaucratic rules meant to improve accountability can undermine state effectiveness. We study a 1492 Ming dynasty reform that shifted military grain delivery from salt merchants to a state relay system with prefecture-to-prefecture handovers and fixed routes. Afterward, court records document more supply shortages at formerly merchant-supplied garrisons than at state-supplied ones. Using 406 defensive battles against foreign invaders, we find the reform reduced victory rates near these garrisons. Declines were largest where resupply mattered most (longer wars, walled-city defenses) and where the state’s rules were most costly (routes crossing more prefectures or exposed to floods, droughts, or rugged terrain).
abstract_zh: 旨在提高问责的官僚规则可能削弱国家效能。我们研究1492年明朝的一项改革，该改革将军事粮食运送从盐商转向国家接力系统，实行府到府的交接和固定路线。此后，宫廷记录显示，原由商人供应的卫所比国家供应的卫所出现更多供应短缺。利用406场抵御外敌入侵的防御战，我们发现该改革降低了这些卫所附近的胜率。下降在补给最重要（更长战争、城墙防御）以及国家规则成本最高（路线跨越更多府或易受洪水、干旱或崎岖地形影响）的地方最大。
title: Bureaucratic Rigidity and Battle Outcomes: Evidence from Military Logistics in the Ming Dynasty
title_zh: 官僚刚性与战斗结果：来自明代军事后勤的证据

abstract: AI agents learn what principals want from what principals choose. We offer a criterion for when a principal's decisions, at every belief an AI might hold, are all the AI needs. For acting, they are. Cautious actions, such as deferring to a person, typically divide the principal's actions into blocks, and for choosing costless evidence, decisions are enough exactly when the same evidence is best in every block. Otherwise, the AI acts as its principal would yet can gather the wrong evidence, and greater capability can turn that error into incorrect actions. Choices between two mistakes reveal what decisions miss.
abstract_zh: AI代理从委托人的选择中学习委托人想要什么。我们提出了一个标准，用以判断在AI可能持有的每一种信念下，委托人的决策是否就是AI所需的全部信息。就行动而言，确实如此。谨慎的行动（例如听从某个人）通常会将委托人的行动划分为若干区块；而对于选择无成本证据而言，当同一证据在每个区块中都是最优时，决策才恰好足够。否则，AI会像其委托人那样行动，却可能收集到错误的证据，而更强的能力会将这一错误转化为不正确的行动。在两种错误之间做出的选择揭示了决策所遗漏的信息。
title: Are Revealed Preferences All You Need for AI Alignment?
title_zh: 显示性偏好足以实现AI对齐吗？

abstract: We examine how information about others’ retirement regret affects annuitization and savings recommendations. In a survey experiment, participants received information about regret over not purchasing annuities or not saving enough for retirement. Responses were concentrated among individuals who underestimated their survival probabilities relative to population benchmarks, consistent with a survival belief-updating mechanism. Among underestimators, annuity regret information increased annuitization recommendations by 16.9 percentage points (approximately 38%), while savings regret information reduced recommendations to significantly increase saving by 15.4 percentage points (approximately 28%). Less regret-averse individuals reduced aggressive savings recommendations, while the positive response to annuity regret information was concentrated among more risk-averse respondents. The annuity effect was strongest among respondents with greater annuity knowledge than less knowledgeable respondents.
abstract_zh: 我们考察关于他人退休后悔的信息如何影响年金化建议和储蓄建议。在一项调查实验中，参与者收到了关于未购买年金或未为退休储蓄足够资金的后悔信息。反应集中在那些相对于人口基准低估自身生存概率的个体中，这与生存信念更新机制相一致。在低估者中，年金后悔信息使年金化建议提高了16.9个百分点（约38%），而储蓄后悔信息使显著增加储蓄的建议降低了15.4个百分点（约28%）。较不厌恶后悔的个体减少了对激进储蓄建议的支持，而对年金后悔信息的积极反应集中在风险厌恶程度较高的受访者中。年金效应在年金知识较多的受访者中比在知识较少的受访者中最强。
title: Regret, Survival Beliefs, and Retirement Recommendations
title_zh: 后悔、生存信念与退休建议

abstract: Deviations from complete financial markets in cross-border investments generate economic welfare costs. This paper shows how to value these costs using standard theory and data based on three main results. Our first result shows how welfare valuations can be derived from a general wealth-to-dividend ratio. Next, we establish how aggregate consumption and exchange rate data can be used to uncover diversifiable goods allocations across countries. Finally, we demonstrate how asset pricing data and models can be used to value deviations from complete markets. The paper outlines a range of applications that fall under this framework, including financial intermediary constraint models.
abstract_zh: 跨境投资中偏离完全金融市场的现象会产生经济福利成本。本文基于三个主要结果，展示了如何利用标准理论和数据来评估这些成本。我们的第一个结果展示了如何从一般的财富-股息比率推导出福利估值。接下来，我们确立了如何利用总消费和汇率数据来揭示各国之间可分散的商品配置。最后，我们展示了如何利用资产定价数据和模型来评估对完全市场的偏离。本文概述了属于该框架的一系列应用，包括金融中介约束模型。

abstract: Scientists can respond to artificial intelligence by pushing the frontier of science and asking new questions, or by deepening their understanding of questions already studied. We study how AI shapes this choice in structural biology, where experiments examine a protein's three-dimensional structure and its function. AlphaFold2, released in 2021, predicts the structure of almost every known protein, with a confidence that varies across proteins. Linking 530,471 proteins to the experiments run on them between 2017 and 2025, we compare how experimental activity changed after 2021 across proteins with more and less confident predictions. Where predictions are more confident, the experimental record adds fewer first structures for proteins far from any relative of known structure. It adds more follow-up experiments on proteins whose structure is already known, and the rise is largest for proteins surrounded by relatives of known structure. A model of experimental choice shows how AlphaFold2 can deepen existing knowledge rather than extend it: a prediction replaces an experiment that would establish a protein's structure, and it lowers the cost of experiments that build on that structure.
abstract_zh: 科学家可以通过推进科学前沿并提出新问题来回应人工智能，也可以通过加深对已有研究问题的理解来回应。我们研究AI如何在结构生物学中塑造这一选择，在该领域中实验检验蛋白质的三维结构及其功能。AlphaFold2于2021年发布，可预测几乎所有已知蛋白质的结构，其置信度因蛋白质而异。我们将530,471种蛋白质与2017年至2025年间对其进行的实验相关联，比较2021年之后预测置信度较高和较低的蛋白质在实验活动上的变化。在预测置信度较高的地方，实验记录为那些与任何已知结构的近亲都相距甚远的蛋白质新增的首次结构较少。它为结构已知的蛋白质新增了更多后续实验，而且这一增长在周围存在已知结构近亲的蛋白质中最大。一个实验选择模型展示了AlphaFold2如何能够加深而非扩展已有知识：一项预测取代了本可确定蛋白质结构的实验，并降低了基于该结构开展实验的成本。
title: How AI Impacts the Quest for Knowledge: Evidence from AlphaFold2
title_zh: AI如何影响知识探索：来自AlphaFold2的证据

abstract: What scientists choose not to publish can be as important as what they do publish. We measure missing research results at the hypothesis level and use this approach to study under-reporting in economics. Across 5,057 pre-registered hypotheses from 317 studies registered on the American Economic Association RCT Registry between 2015 and 2017, only 42% have publicly available results eight to nine years after pre-registration. Among the available results, 64% are null, and we find little evidence that null results are disproportionately missing. In an RCT, direct engagement with authors increases the share of hypotheses with available results by 6.2 percentage points, while raising awareness alone has no significant effect and additional research assistance provides no further improvement. Direct engagement also increases explanations for unavailable results, reducing the share of hypotheses that remain unaccounted for by 16.4 percentage points. The findings document extensive under-reporting in economics that does not appear to be driven primarily by the suppression of null results, and suggest that reporting pre-registered results may need to become a standard part of the research process rather than something recovered years later.
abstract_zh: 科学家选择不发表的内容可能与他們发表的内容同样重要。我们在假设层面衡量缺失的研究结果，并利用这一方法研究经济学中的报告不足问题。在2015年至2017年间在美国经济学会RCT注册中心注册的317项研究的5,057个预注册假设中，只有42%在预注册后八到九年有公开可用的结果。在可用的结果中，64%为零结果，我们几乎没有发现零结果被不成比例地缺失的证据。在一项RCT中，与作者直接接触使有可用结果的假设比例提高了6.2个百分点，而仅提高意识没有显著效果，额外提供研究协助也没有进一步改善。直接接触还增加了对不可用结果的解释，使仍未得到说明的假设比例降低了16.4个百分点。这些发现记录了经济学中广泛的报告不足现象，而这一现象似乎并非主要由对零结果的压制所驱动，并表明报告预注册结果可能需要成为研究过程的标准组成部分，而不是多年后才被找回的东西。
title: Beyond Publication Bias: Characterizing and Understanding Missing Results in Economics
title_zh: 超越发表偏倚：刻画和理解经济学中缺失的结果

abstract: Empirical researchers are often interested in the relative causal impact of individuals or institutions such as teachers, schools, hospitals, or neighborhoods. Regression-based estimates of such unit-specific parameters are often noisy; empirical Bayes (eB) methods can help isolate the signal from the estimation noise. This article provides an overview of eB methodology, showing how eB shrinkage can improve compound decisions—such as selecting individuals with the highest causal impacts—even when the working model motivating the shrinkage is misspecified. Not all analyses benefit from eB shrinkage, however, and we discuss which types of causal summaries are best estimated directly and how to do so robustly. We illustrate practical takeaways with a running analysis of public elementary and middle school value-added.
abstract_zh: 实证研究者常关注个体或机构（如教师、学校、医院或社区）的相对因果影响。基于回归的此类单位特定参数估计往往噪声较大；经验贝叶斯（eB）方法有助于从估计噪声中分离信号。本文概述eB方法，展示即使推动收缩的工作模型设定有误，eB收缩也能改善复合决策——例如选择因果影响最高的个体。然而，并非所有分析都能从eB收缩中受益；我们讨论哪些类型的因果汇总最适合直接估计，以及如何稳健地做到这一点。我们通过对公立中小学增值的连续分析来说明实际要点。
title: Shrink Responsibly: Empirical Bayes in Economics
title_zh: 负责任地收缩：经济学中的经验贝叶斯方法

abstract: We study the impact of the 2025 sudden freeze then subsequent thaw of US foreign aid on HIV prevention, treatment, infection, and death. In Zambia, HIV-related aid was administered through two agencies. Activities under one were disrupted for several months, and those under the other much less. Comprehensive data from all Zambian health facilities reveal immediate differential reductions in preventive HIV measures that mostly later recovered, followed by more HIV-positive pregnant women, more HIV-exposed births, more opportunistic infections, and more recorded deaths. For example, after one year we observe a 14% [95% CI: 3, 25] increase in HIV-positive pregnant women and a 26% [95% CI: 8, 45] increase in deaths among people living with HIV who were receiving antiretroviral therapy.
abstract_zh: 我们研究2025年美国对外援助突然冻结及随后解冻对HIV预防、治疗、感染和死亡的影响。在赞比亚，HIV相关援助通过两个机构实施。其中一个机构的活动被中断了数月，而另一个机构的活动受影响小得多。来自赞比亚所有卫生机构的综合数据显示，预防性HIV措施立即出现差异性减少，随后大多恢复，接着出现更多HIV阳性孕妇、更多HIV暴露新生儿、更多机会性感染和更多记录死亡。例如，一年后我们观察到HIV阳性孕妇增加14%[95% CI：3, 25]，接受抗逆转录病毒治疗的HIV感染者死亡增加26%[95% CI：8, 45]。
title: Mortality Effects of the 2025 US Aid Freeze: Evidence from Zambia
title_zh: 2025年美国援助冻结的死亡率效应：来自赞比亚的证据

abstract: Democrats and Republicans express some sharply different views about tax policy, but whether these ideological divisions translate into partisan differences in taxpayer behavior is far less clear. We study this question in the context of a common form of tax avoidance: property tax appeals. In a survey, we find that Americans, on average, believe Republican homeowners are more likely to appeal their property taxes than Democratic homeowners with similarly valued homes. Yet linking administrative property tax records from Dallas County with voting records reveals that this stereotype is not borne out in practice: the partisan gap in appeals is small, both in absolute terms (0.29 percentage points) and relative to several demographic gaps in appeals we use as benchmarks. Similar appeal rates could nonetheless conceal differences in motives. Using quasi-experimental and field experimental evidence, we find that Democrats and Republicans appeal for broadly similar reasons. In sum, despite differing tax policy preferences and public perceptions about their behavior, Democrats and Republicans are strikingly similar in both their propensity to appeal their property taxes and their underlying motives.
abstract_zh: 民主党人和共和党人对税收政策表达了一些截然不同的观点，但这些意识形态分歧是否转化为纳税人行为上的党派差异则远不清楚。我们在房产税上诉这一常见避税形式的背景下研究这个问题。在一项调查中，我们发现美国人平均认为共和党房主比拥有类似价值房屋的民主党房主更可能对其房产税提出上诉。然而，将达拉斯县的行政房产税记录与投票记录关联后发现，这种刻板印象在实践中并未得到证实：上诉中的党派差距很小，无论是绝对值（0.29个百分点）还是相对于我们用作基准的若干人口统计上诉差距而言。相似的上诉率仍可能掩盖动机差异。使用准实验和实地实验证据，我们发现民主党人和共和党人上诉的原因大体相似。总之，尽管税收政策偏好不同且公众对其行为的看法不同，民主党人和共和党人在上诉房产税的倾向及其潜在动机上惊人地相似。
title: Are Republicans and Democrats Different Taxpayers? Evidence From Property Tax Appeals
title_zh: 共和党人和民主党人是不同的纳税人吗？来自房产税上诉的证据

abstract: The United States and China have each built the capacity to inflict serious economic damage on each other. This paper argues that the resulting mutual vulnerability now constrains both sides and prevents further economic decoupling. The paper maps this contest across two stacks: the real economy stack of computing, semiconductors and rare earths, and the financial stack of dollar dominance and digital finance. On the real side, an analysis of global earnings call reports, run through large language models, suggests that this mutual vulnerability was already shaping the global corporate narrative in 2025. On the financial side, the paper argues that digital finance could tip this balance either way. Portable U.S. dollar-denominated digital assets could deepen U.S. dollar dominance and erode China's capital controls, tilting the balance toward Washington and inviting more fragmentation. A drift of transactions onto offshore rails like Tether could do the opposite, eroding Washington’s enforcement power behind sanctions and, counterintuitively, restraining it. Both the U.S. and China, meanwhile, run internally inconsistent policies. The U.S. is closing its door to trade while keeping an open financial account, and China is doing the reverse. These configurations are ultimately unsustainable and could undermine the arsenals that sustain the equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 美国和中国都已建立起对彼此造成严重经济损害的能力。本文认为，由此产生的相互脆弱性现在约束着双方，并阻止进一步的经济脱钩。本文在两个技术栈上描绘这场竞争：计算、半导体和稀土构成的实体经济栈，以及美元主导地位和数字金融构成的金融栈。在实体方面，通过大型语言模型对全球财报电话会议报告的分析表明，这种相互脆弱性在2025年已经在塑造全球企业叙事。在金融方面，本文认为数字金融可能使这一平衡向任一方向倾斜。可携带的美元计价数字资产可能加深美元主导地位并侵蚀中国的资本管制，使平衡向华盛顿倾斜并招致更多碎片化。交易向Tether等离岸轨道漂移则可能产生相反效果，侵蚀华盛顿制裁背后的执法权力，并且反直觉地约束它。与此同时，美国和中国都运行着内部不一致的政策。美国在关闭贸易大门的同时保持金融账户开放，中国则相反。这些配置最终不可持续，并可能削弱维持均衡的武器库。

abstract: We introduce an empirical framework to quantify the welfare impact of market power, through coordinated production decisions by a cartel, while allowing for other distortions. We contrast two novel concepts – the marginal and the infra-marginal welfare loss – to a naive approach that fails to recognize the existence of other distortions operating alongside market power. We apply the framework to measure the impact of market power of OPEC in the global crude oil market. We leverage unique micro data on cost and production to quantify the deadweight loss and productive inefficiency due to the OPEC cartel. From 1970 onward, the naive approach implies that OPEC generated 2.2 trillion dollars of welfare losses, two-thirds from productive inefficiency and one-third from deadweight loss. Eliminating cost-minimization violations outside the cartel shrinks losses to around 0.7 trillion dollars, indicating that other frictions in the oil market are complementary to OPEC’s market power.
abstract_zh: 我们引入一个实证框架，通过卡特尔协调生产决策来量化市场势力的福利影响，同时允许其他扭曲存在。我们将两个新概念——边际福利损失和超边际福利损失——与未能认识到市场势力之外其他扭曲存在的朴素方法进行对比。我们将该框架应用于衡量OPEC在全球原油市场中的市场势力影响。我们利用关于成本和生产的独特微观数据来量化OPEC卡特尔导致的无谓损失和生产无效率。自1970年以来，朴素方法意味着OPEC造成了2.2万亿美元的福利损失，其中三分之二来自生产无效率，三分之一来自无谓损失。消除卡特尔之外的违反成本最小化行为将损失缩减至约0.7万亿美元，表明石油市场中的其他摩擦与OPEC市场势力具有互补性。
title: Beyond the First Best: Welfare and OPEC Market Power
title_zh: 超越最优：福利与OPEC市场势力

abstract: Low Emission Zones (LEZs), which exclude polluting vehicles from parts of a city, are spreading. Yet how their design affects welfare is poorly understood. Unlike price instruments, LEZs ration access inefficiently, imposing costs on inframarginal drivers of restricted vehicles. In our model, welfare is quasi-convex in LEZ size, yielding bang-bang principles: LEZs should be as large as possible or not implemented at all; cleaner vehicles (e.g., hybrids) could be exempt as transition technologies but later restricted, which may require planner commitment. Using new-car purchases, we find Madrid’s LEZ shifted buyers toward cleaner cars, but the surplus losses of switchers and inframarginal drivers exceeded emission savings.
abstract_zh: 低排放区（LEZ）将污染车辆排除在城市部分地区之外，正在扩散。然而，其设计如何影响福利却鲜为人知。与价格工具不同，LEZ低效地配给通行权，对被限制车辆的非边际驾驶员施加成本。在我们的模型中，福利对LEZ规模是拟凸的，产生 bang-bang 原则：LEZ应尽可能大，或者根本不实施；更清洁的车辆（例如混合动力车）可以作为过渡技术获得豁免，但随后受到限制，这可能需要规划者的承诺。使用新车购买数据，我们发现马德里的LEZ使购买者转向更清洁的汽车，但转换者和非边际驾驶员的剩余损失超过了排放节省。
title: Designing Low Emission Zones: Theory and Evidence
title_zh: 设计低排放区：理论与证据

abstract: We document five facts about payment stablecoins using wallet-level blockchain data from 2020 to 2025. First, stablecoins serve as a transaction currency: onchain volume exceeds Bitcoin’s despite a much smaller supply, velocity has risen sharply, and transactions have shifted toward low-value transfers. Second, using transaction timing to refine exchange-based attribution, we find activity spread across the Americas, Europe, and Asia and fewer cross-regional flows than the standard method implies. Third, we estimate a structural cash-management model on the holdings data and find that the costs of accessing stablecoin wallets have fallen since 2023. Fourth, stablecoins are becoming the settlement currency of a fast-growing onchain credit market, and their growth appears to reallocate rather than destroy credit. Fifth, smart contracts are involved in about a third of Ethereum stablecoin transactions and over two thirds of volume, and protocols such as x402 demonstrate sub-cent machine-to-machine payments. Stablecoins behave as tokenized money, with implications for financial markets and regulation.
abstract_zh: 我们使用2020年至2025年的钱包级区块链数据记录了关于支付稳定币的五个事实。第一，稳定币充当交易货币：尽管供应量小得多，链上交易量仍超过比特币，流通速度急剧上升，交易已转向低价值转账。第二，利用交易时间改进基于交易所的归属，我们发现活动分布在美洲、欧洲和亚洲，且跨区域流动比标准方法所暗示的要少。第三，我们在持有数据上估计了一个结构性现金管理模型，发现自2023年以来访问稳定币钱包的成本已经下降。第四，稳定币正成为快速增长的链上信贷市场的结算货币，其增长似乎是在重新分配而非摧毁信贷。第五，智能合约涉及约三分之一的以太坊稳定币交易和超过三分之二的交易量，而x402等协议展示了低于一美分的机器对机器支付。稳定币表现为代币化货币，对金融市场和监管具有影响。
title: Five Facts About Stablecoins
title_zh: 关于稳定币的五个事实

abstract: Can tax subsidies expand the geographic reach of startup investing? Despite decades of growth, venture capital (VC) remains concentrated in a handful of metropolitan areas, leaving most of the country with limited access to startup financing. We study the 2009–2010 enhancement of the Qualified Small Business Stock (QSBS) program, which eliminated federal capital gains taxes on investments in qualifying startups. By raising the payoff to success, the reform made riskier investments more attractive, including entry into unfamiliar markets. This incentive is especially strong for VC funds. Relative to similarly sized metros that already had VC, the reform raised the probability that a previously unserved metro received VC investment in qualifying sectors by 8 to 10 percentage points. There was no comparable increase in sectors excluded from QSBS or among angel investors, who receive the same tax benefit. Startups in newly served markets performed like those in other non-hub markets, created high-wage jobs, and attracted scientific and technical workers, some from established hubs. Our findings suggest that a sufficiently large subsidy can extend VC into markets it had long bypassed, even with no requirement on where startups are located.
abstract_zh: 税收补贴能扩大创业投资的地理覆盖范围吗？尽管经历了数十年的增长，风险投资（VC）仍集中在少数大都市区，使全国大部分地区获得创业融资的机会有限。我们研究2009–2010年合格小企业股票（QSBS）计划的强化，该计划取消了对合格初创企业投资的联邦资本利得税。通过提高成功的回报，该改革使风险更高的投资更具吸引力，包括进入不熟悉的市场。这种激励对VC基金尤其强烈。相对于已经拥有VC的类似规模大都市区，该改革使先前未获得服务的大都市区在合格行业获得VC投资的概率提高了8至10个百分点。在被排除在QSBS之外的行业或获得相同税收优惠的天使投资者中，没有可比的增长。新获得服务市场中的初创企业表现与其他非中心市场中的企业相似，创造了高工资就业，并吸引了科学和技术工作者，其中一些人来自成熟中心。我们的发现表明，足够大的补贴可以将VC扩展到它长期绕过的市场，即使对初创企业所在地没有要求。
title: Democratizing Venture Capital: Tax Incentives and the Geographic Expansion of Startup Investing
title_zh: 风险投资的民主化：税收激励与创业投资的地理扩张

abstract: This article documents the integration of the American capital market with the first long-run, geolocated, firm-level record of the asset holdings of large institutional investors: over 100,000 holdings of life insurers, 1870–1940. Between 1880 and 1890 the mean distance of insurers’ bonds from home more than doubled and their home-state share fell from over half to under a quarter. The shift occurred within firms, across bond classes and charters. Mortgage lending was national wherever state law permitted it. Integration was largely complete by 1890.
abstract_zh: 本文利用首个长期、地理定位、企业层面的大型机构投资者资产持有记录，记录了美国资本市场的整合：1870–1940年寿险公司超过100,000笔持有。1880年至1890年间，保险公司债券距本地的平均距离增加了一倍以上，其本州份额从超过一半降至不到四分之一。这一转变发生在企业内部的债券类别和特许状之间。只要州法律允许，抵押贷款就是全国性的。到1890年，整合基本完成。
title: The Emergence of a National Capital Market,1870–1940
title_zh: 全国资本市场的出现，1870–1940

abstract: Does treating addiction improve economic circumstances as well as health? Using two decades of Veterans Health Administration records on over 140,000 patients with opioid use disorder and consumer credit data, we exploit staggered facility-level buprenorphine adoption and quasi-random emergency physician assignment. A five-percentage-point increase in the share of clinicians with buprenorphine prescribing experience doubles overdose survivors’ long-term medication use and reduces two-year mortality by an estimated 3.7 percentage points. Instrumenting receipt yields a 22 percent credit score gain. At $300,000 per statistical life-year, estimated survival benefits alone exceed added medical costs within three years
abstract_zh: 治疗成瘾能改善经济状况以及健康吗？使用退伍军人健康管理局二十年来对超过140,000名阿片类药物使用障碍患者的记录和消费者信用数据，我们利用设施层面丁丙诺啡采用的交错推行和准随机的急诊医生分配。具有丁丙诺啡处方经验的临床医生比例增加五个百分点，使过量幸存者的长期药物使用翻倍，并使两年死亡率估计降低3.7个百分点。对接受治疗进行工具变量估计，得到22%的信用评分提升。按每统计生命年300,000美元计算，仅估计的生存收益就在三年内超过增加的医疗成本
title: Does Treating Addiction Rebuild Lives? Evidence from Buprenorphine
title_zh: 治疗成瘾能重建生活吗？来自丁丙诺啡的证据

abstract: Some social insurance programs, including the Medicare program in the United States, allow beneficiaries to choose between public and private insurance firms. In these types of programs, the government will often provide a voucher to those who opt for private firms. A key policy decision is the level of this voucher, and a key input to that decision is the elasticity of enrollment in the public versus the private option with respect to the size of the voucher. We estimate this elasticity in the Medicare program, where recent work has provided remarkably little evidence on how Medicare Advantage (MA) enrollment responds to payment despite the program’s rapid growth. We leverage the fact that the formula determining county-level “benchmark” payments (vouchers) involves coarse thresholds based on county-level spending and counties occasionally move across these thresholds, providing a shock to the vouchers unrelated to beneficiary demand. Using several complementary estimation strategies, we find that a 1 percent increase in a county’s benchmark raises MA enrollment by roughly half a percentage point within three years, implying an elasticity of about 2. Applying this estimate to a policy counterfactual that sets benchmarks at 95 percent of county fee-for-service spending implies a decline in MA enrollment of about 6.1 percentage points, or roughly one-quarter of our sample. We also provide suggestive evidence, consistent with prior work, that the increase in benchmarks gets passed through in the form of additional benefits, providing a mechanism for the enrollment increases.
abstract_zh: 一些社会保险项目，包括美国的Medicare项目，允许受益人在公共和私人保险公司之间进行选择。在这类项目中，政府通常会向选择私人公司的人提供代金券。一个关键的政策决策是代金券的水平，而该决策的一个关键输入是公共选项与私人选项的参保人数相对于代金券规模的弹性。我们在Medicare项目中估计这一弹性，尽管该项目快速增长，但近期研究提供的关于Medicare Advantage（MA）参保如何对支付作出反应的证据却出奇地少。我们利用这样一个事实：决定县级“基准”支付（代金券）的公式涉及基于县级支出的粗略阈值，且县偶尔会跨越这些阈值，从而提供了一种与受益人需求无关的代金券冲击。使用多种互补的估计策略，我们发现一个县的基准提高1%会使MA参保人数在三年内增加约半个百分点，意味着弹性约为2。将这一估计应用于一个将基准设定为县按服务收费支出95%的政策反事实，意味着MA参保人数下降约6.1个百分点，或约我们样本的四分之一。我们还提供了与先前研究一致的提示性证据，即基准的增加会以额外福利的形式传导，为参保增加提供了一种机制。
title: The Effects of Private Plan Subsidies on Enrollment: Evidence from Medicare Advantage
title_zh: 私人计划补贴对参保的影响：来自Medicare Advantage的证据

abstract: We study how individuals form expectations about fiscal adjustment. Using survey data from more than 27,000 respondents across 13 countries, we jointly elicit beliefs about current fiscal conditions, expectations of tax increases and spending cuts, and open-ended explanations for those expectations. We classify these explanations into economic mental models, political narratives, and experience-based heuristics. Respondents reporting similar fiscal conditions nevertheless form systematically different expectations of adjustment. Economic mental models are associated with stronger expectations of tax increases and spending cuts in the fiscal configurations we examine, whereas experience-based reasoning is associated with weaker adjustment expectations. These differences are also reflected in intended economic behavior and portfolio allocations. In a randomized experiment, fiscal information increases the likelihood that respondents articulate economic reasoning, primarily among responses that would otherwise fall outside the three primary frameworks.
abstract_zh: 我们研究个体如何形成对财政调整的预期。利用来自13个国家超过27,000名受访者的调查数据，我们联合 elicits 对当前财政状况的信念、对增税和削减支出的预期，以及对这些预期的开放式解释。我们将这些解释分类为经济心理模型、政治叙事和基于经验的启发式。报告相似财政状况的受访者 nevertheless 形成了系统不同的调整预期。在我们考察的财政配置中，经济心理模型与更强的增税和削减支出预期相关联，而基于经验的推理与较弱的调整预期相关联。这些差异也反映在预期的经济行为和投资组合配置中。在一项随机实验中，财政信息提高了受访者阐述经济推理的可能性，主要是在那些原本会落在三个主要框架之外的回答中。
title: Mental Models of Fiscal Policy
title_zh: 财政政策的心理模型

abstract: Proposals to shorten the workweek are back on the policy agenda in Europe and the US. This column draws on France’s 35-hour reform to assess two central promises: work-sharing and productivity gains. In 2000, France cut the standard workweek from 39 to 35 hours at unchanged monthly pay and paired it with payroll tax cuts for employers. The authors find that the shorter workweek alone would have reduced employment by 4%, which the tax cuts fully offset. Productivity rose, but not enough to prevent a fall in output. Lower-skill workers bore most of the costs.
authors: Pauline Carry, Claire Montialoux, Elio Nimier-David, Alexandra Roulet, Nina Roussille
title: Shorter workweeks do not share work: Evidence from France's 35-hour reform

abstract: Cross-country data on what governments do are scarce. This column introduces the Global Fiscal Actions dataset, a new quarterly database of tax and spending measures in 142 countries since 1990, constructed using large language models to classify fiscal actions by their direction, instrument, motivation, implementation status, and size. Fiscal actions are frequent, typically small, predominantly expansionary, and spending-based, although fiscal sustainability is the most cited motivation. Over the past decade, spending actions have become less procyclical, while tax actions remain acyclical. Fiscal actions are synchronised across countries only during global recessions, and multipliers vary more within income groups than between them.
authors: Hites Ahir, Miyoko Asai, Matthieu Bellon, Maria Chiara Cavalleri, Shuvam Das, Davide Furceri, Faizaan Kisat, Aiko Mineshima, Irene Rausell Moreno, Vishal Parmar, Nikhil Patel, Adrian Peralta-Alva
title: Inside fiscal policy: A new dataset on government actions

abstract: This study examines how road investments affected structural transformation in rural Mali using an exhaustive panel of localities constructed from census micro-data and a difference-indifferences identification strategy. Between 1998 and 2009, gaining paved-road access increased a rural locality’s population by 13.5 percent, the male share by 1 percentage point, and the share of non-agricultural employment by 6.7 percentage points. Population gains were concentrated in localities near cities, while non-agricultural employment increased in remote areas, suggesting population growth without structural transformation near cities, but sectoral convergence in remote localities. New or upgraded road connections were also associated with improved local welfare.

abstract: We introduce a new methodology for eliciting incompleteness. Rather than incentivizing choices directly, we use choices to estimate preferences and incentivize based on these estimated preferences. This allows individuals to report incompleteness and indifference directly. While incompleteness is rare at the choice level, about 40% of subjects express incompleteness in at least some choices, and revealed incompleteness is consistent with theoretical predictions. When we force subjects to choose, we observe more inconsistencies and preference reversals. Evidence suggests there is incompleteness that is indirectly revealed—in up to 98% of subjects—in addition to what we directly measure.
title: Revealed Incomplete Preferences

abstract: I study the financial crowding out effect of local government bank debt on corporate credit, investment, and output, using French administrative data over 2006-2018. Exploiting plausibly exogenous variation across banks, I show that a AC1-increase in bank-specific demand for local government debt reduces that bank’s corporate lending by AC0.5 and lowers investment for its borrowers. Combining these reduced-form estimates and a model, I find that crowding out causes an aggregate output shortfall of AC0.2 per AC1-increase in demand for local government debt. These results indicate that constraints on financing supply reduce the stimulus effect of debt-financed government spending.
title: The Crowding Out Effect of Local Government Debt: Micro- and Macro-Estimates

abstract: We study the impact of an identity-based ethics training program for police officers in Ghana using a randomized field experiment. The training aimed to re-activate intrinsic motivations and foster a shared identity as “Agents of Change.” Data collected 20 months post-training show improvements in officers’ values and attitudes toward citizens, and reduced willingness to act unethically, as measured by an incentivized cheating game. District-level administrative data, available for a subsample of districts, show short-run improvements in field behavior. Our findings suggest that identitybased training can improve officers’ attitudes and behaviors, though sustained impact may require periodic reinforcement and organizational support.
title: Proud to Belong: The Impact of Ethics Training on Police Officers in Ghana

abstract: We study the large-scale experimental rollout of a platform that reduced search and matching frictions in Ugandan agricultural markets by connecting buyers and sellers. Market integration improved substantially: trade increased and price gaps fell. Interpreting the experiment through a trade model, we estimate treatment effects accounting for equilibrium changes that impact control markets. The intervention reduced fixed trade costs by 20% and increased trade flows between treated markets by 7% and across all markets by 1%. Scale economies shaped engagement: few farmers used the platform, but equilibrium price convergence from improved arbitrage by larger traders passed through to farm revenue.
title: Search Costs, Intermediation, and Trade: Experimental Evidence from Ugandan Agricultural Markets

abstract: Business sentiment is closely watched, but measurement is slow and costly: surveys reach a limited number of firms, arrive periodically, and take time to field and compile. We show that large language models hold the potential to address some of these shortcomings. We prompt an LLM to role-play as the CFO of a specific company on a specific date, for every public-company CFO who responded to the Duke–Federal Reserve CFO Survey from 2002- 2025. We find that LLM-generated forecasts reasonably match the cross-section of CFO expectations, with accuracy increasing with the amount of information provided to the LLM. We discuss the potential as well as the hurdles to using digital twins to mimic individual decision-makers.
abstract_zh: 商业情绪受到密切关注，但测量缓慢且成本高昂：调查仅覆盖有限数量的企业，定期进行，且需要时间实地开展和汇总。我们表明大型语言模型有潜力解决其中一些不足。对于2002—2025年期间回应杜克—美联储CFO调查的每一位上市公司CFO，我们提示大型语言模型在特定日期角色扮演特定公司的CFO。我们发现大型语言模型生成的预测与CFO预期的横截面合理匹配，准确性随着提供给大型语言模型的信息量增加而提高。我们讨论了使用数字孪生模仿个体决策者的潜力以及障碍。
title: CFOs Meet LLMs
title_zh: CFO与大型语言模型
